## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic completed 132 captures during May 2020. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in the usual way apart from routine leave. The reported activity figure represents the total number of captures recorded for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. There were 3 ungradable captures, resulting in an ungradable rate of 2.3 per cent. These records could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the graded results. The rate is provided alongside the underlying count to support review of the site’s monthly performance.

## Grading

A total of 25 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. This measure records the typical interval between capture and completion of grading. Overall, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide a concise account of service delivery at Harbour Eye Clinic during May 2020. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and the recorded results are presented for routine operational monitoring.
